name: bld5_pisano_two_pow
informal: Uses Mathlib2.lib_fib_period_iff, Mathlib2.bld3_pisano_dvd_of_period, Mathlib2.bld3_pisano_dvd_pisano_of_dvd and Mathlib2.lib_pisano_dvd_iff_period: prove by induction on j ≥ 1, using Nat.fib_two_mul and Nat.fib_two_mul_add_one, that F_{3·2^j} ≡ 2^(j+2) mod 2^(j+3) and F_{3·2^j+1} ≡ 1 + 2^(j+1) mod 2^(j+2) (base F_6 = 8, F_7 = 13). Upper bound: F_{3·2^k} ≡ 0, F_{3·2^k+1} ≡ 1 mod 2^(k+1), so lib_fib_period_iff + bld3_pisano_dvd_of_period give pisano ∣ 3·2^k. Lower bound by induction on k: bld3_pisano_dvd_pisano_of_dvd gives 3·2^(k-1) = pisano(2^k) ∣ pisano(2^(k+1)), so the value is 3·2^(k-1) or 3·2^k; the former is not a period (lib_pisano_dvd_iff_period at i = 1, or i = 0 when k = 1) because F_{3·2^(k-1)+1} ≡ 1 + 2^k ≢ 1 mod 2^(k+1). Base: pisano 2 = 3 by direct check.
source: builds on Mathlib2.lib_fib_period_iff, Mathlib2.bld3_pisano_dvd_of_period, Mathlib2.bld3_pisano_dvd_pisano_of_dvd, Mathlib2.lib_pisano_dvd_iff_period
